usedFor: Product teams use LoopedIn to collect feedback with “Create Idea” and share news with “Create Announcement”.

bestTemplate.name: “Create Roadmap Card” in LoopedIn
bestTemplate.why: It adds a card to the roadmap, so planned work stays visible.

watchOut: “Delete Idea”, “Delete Roadmap Card” and “Delete Announcement” remove items, so keep them behind approval.
